lines.en: I'm Peppa Pig. This is my little brother, George. This is Mummy Pig. And this is Daddy Pig.
lines.zh: 我是小猪佩奇。这是我的弟弟乔治，这是猪妈妈，这是猪爸爸。

lines.en: Mr. Fox's Shop. Mummy and Daddy Pig are wrapping up a present.
lines.zh: 狐狸先生的商店。猪妈妈和猪爸爸正在包装一件礼物。

lines.en: Ooh, a present! Is it for me or George?
lines.zh: 哦，一件礼物！是给我的还是给乔治的？

lines.en: No, Peppa, it's not for you or George. Oh, is it a toy?
lines.zh: 不是，佩奇，既不是给你也不是给乔治的。哦，那是玩具吗？

lines.en: No, it's a glass vase. That's a bit of a boring present! Ho ho ho, it's a present for grown-ups. We've bought this for Granny and Grandpa Pig. It's their wedding anniversary. Can me and George buy them a present, too? That's very sweet of you, Peppa, but presents can cost a lot of money. We've got money in our piggy bank!
lines.zh: 不是，是一个玻璃花瓶。这礼物有点无聊吧！呵呵呵，这是送大人的礼物。这是我们给猪爷爷和猪奶奶买的。今天是他们的结婚纪念日。那我和乔治也能给他们买件礼物吗？佩奇，你真贴心，不过礼物可能要花很多钱呢。我们存钱罐里有钱！

lines.en: Peppa and George have one penny and two buttons to spend.
lines.zh: 佩奇和乔治有一枚便士和两颗纽扣可以花。

lines.en: Okay, let's go shopping! This is Mr. Fox's shop.
lines.zh: 好吧，那我们去买东西！这就是狐狸先生的商店。

lines.en: Hello there! Can I help you? It's Granny and Grandpa Pig's wedding anniversary! They're both very old and need a present. My shop has everything! I'm sure you'll find something you like!
lines.zh: 你们好！需要帮忙吗？今天是猪爷爷和猪奶奶的结婚纪念日！他们俩年纪都很大了，需要一件礼物。我店里什么都有！我相信你们一定能找到喜欢的东西！

lines.en: A big teddy! I love it! This can be the present! Peppa, the present is not for you, it's for Granny and Grandpa! Oh, yes!
lines.zh: 一只大泰迪熊！我喜欢！就买这个当礼物吧！佩奇，这礼物不是给你的，是给爷爷奶奶的！哦，对哦！

lines.en: Oh, look! Funny teeth! They're wind-up joke teeth. Very popular! Can they be the present for Granny and Grandpa? I think Granny and Grandpa have all the teeth they need, Peppa!
lines.zh: 哦，你看！搞笑假牙！这是上发条的整蛊假牙。很受欢迎的！它们能给爷爷奶奶当礼物吗？佩奇，我觉得爷爷奶奶的牙已经够用啦！

lines.en: Do your Granny and Grandpa like gardening and digging? Yes! Then why not get them a bucket and spade each? Buy one, get one free! They've already got spades and buckets and forks and everything! Oh, dear!
lines.zh: 你们的爷爷奶奶喜欢园艺和挖土吗？喜欢！那为什么不给他们各买一个小桶和一把铲子呢？买一送一！他们已经有铲子、小桶、耙子，什么都有了！哦，天哪！

lines.en: I know! Grandpa likes sailing, he has a boat! Say no more! I have everything a sailor could ever wish for! Do you have pirate's treasure? Uh, everything except pirate's treasure! Oh!
lines.zh: 我知道了！爷爷喜欢航海，他有一艘船！不用多说了！水手想要的东西我这儿应有尽有！那你有海盗的宝藏吗？呃，除了海盗的宝藏，什么都有！哦！

lines.en: Do Granny and Grandpa like antiques? What does antique mean? Antique means old and rare! Usually, yes! But my antiques are brand new! That chair comes in a set of twelve! Nice, isn't it? Is it made of oak? Yes, it's made of plastic oak! Is it comfortable? You mustn't sit on it! Antique chairs are not for sitting on! So, what do you do with them? You look at them! That's not much fun, even for a grown-up!
lines.zh: 爷爷奶奶喜欢古董吗？古董是什么意思？古董就是又老又稀有！通常是这样！不过我这些古董是全新的！那把椅子是十二件套里的呢！挺好看的，是不是？它是橡木做的吗？是的，是塑料橡木做的！那坐着舒服吗？你可千万别坐上去！古董椅子不是用来坐的！那你们用它做什么？就看着呀！那可没什么意思，就连大人也会觉得无聊！

lines.en: Buying a present for Granny and Grandpa is hard work! I don't understand! My shop sells everything! There must be something you like! There is!
lines.zh: 给爷爷奶奶买礼物真不容易！我真搞不懂！我店里什么都有卖！总该有你们喜欢的东西吧！有的！

lines.en: I like this teddy, and I think Granny and Grandpa would like it, too! Oh, oh, let's buy the teddy, then! A very good choice! Who's going to pay?
lines.zh: 我喜欢这只泰迪熊，而且我觉得爷爷奶奶也会喜欢的！哦，哦，那我们就买这只泰迪熊吧！非常好的选择！谁来付钱呢？

lines.en: One penny and two buttons! Here's your change, one button! Thank you, Mr. Fox!
lines.zh: 一枚便士和两颗纽扣！这是找你的钱，一颗纽扣！谢谢你，狐狸先生！

lines.en: Peppa and her family have come to give Granny and Grandpa Pig their presents. Granny Pig, Grandpa Pig!
lines.zh: 佩奇一家来给猪爷爷和猪奶奶送礼物了。猪奶奶，猪爷爷！

lines.en: Hello, my little ones! Happy anniversary!
lines.zh: 你们好，我的小宝贝们！结婚纪念日快乐！

lines.en: Oh, another glass vase! It's a grown-up present. That's why it's a bit boring. It's lovely! We'll put it with our other glass vases! George and me bought you a present, too! I hope you like it!
lines.zh: 哦，又一个玻璃花瓶！这是送大人的礼物。所以它才有点无聊。真好看！我们把它和其他玻璃花瓶放在一起吧！我和乔治也给你们买了一件礼物！希望你们喜欢！

lines.en: A teddy bear for Grandpa and me! Thank you, Peppa and George! He's very good at cuddling! Does he have a name? Um, he's called Eddie the Teddy! And what does Eddie like to eat? Chocolate and broccoli! That's the best present we've ever had!
lines.zh: 是送给爷爷和我的一只泰迪熊！谢谢你们，佩奇和乔治！它特别适合抱抱！它有名字吗？嗯，它叫泰迪艾迪！那艾迪喜欢吃什么呢？巧克力和西兰花！这是我们收到过最好的礼物！

lines.en: Oh, but if Eddie's going to live here, he'll need children to play with! We can play with him, Granny! And every time you visit us, he'll be here for you to play with! Oh, goody!
lines.zh: 哦，不过如果艾迪要住在这儿，它就需要有孩子陪它玩呀！奶奶，我们可以陪它玩！而且每次你们来看我们，它都会在这儿陪你们玩！哦，太好啦！
